newsitem.title: FRANCE: France aims for Thomson-CSF sale choice by June 30.
newsitem.headline: France aims for Thomson-CSF sale choice by June 30.

text.p: The French finance ministry said on Tuesday it would publish the tender for the privatisation of Thomson-CSF on Wednesday, that bids had to be in by March 28 and that it aimed to choose the successful candidate before June 30.
The ministry said in a statement the conditions imposed on the sale of defence electronics group Thomson-CSF, which is 58 percent state-owned, would be made available to candidates at the ministry.
"Candidatures who are considered eligible will get further information and will have to submit firm offers at the latest by May 7 at 12 o'clock (midday)," said the statement.
"The choice of the buyer and the sale price will be decided by the finance minister (Jean Arthuis) in line with the advice of the Privatisation Commission," it said.
"The government aims to choose the new majority shareholder in Thomson-CSF before June 30, 1997," it added.
